description: The utility implicitly requires existing quantization_config metadata but does not validate that precondition before writing artifacts.
trigger: Invoke recompile on an otherwise supported input whose config.json lacks quantization_config and whose assembly reaches metadata writing.
expected_behavior: Reject unsupported input before writing, or supply complete metadata arguments.
actual_behavior: The utility supplies neither cal_rows nor cal_cols nor apply_out_scales. The compiler's fallback accesses cal_rows and raises KeyError after shard writing and auxiliary-file copying.

verification.description: Compared the new argument builder with the unchanged conversion caller, whose prepare function supplies calibration and output-scale keys.
verification.limits: Reach is conditional on successful earlier model construction and tensor assembly.

verification.description: Transcribed the missing-key lookup and observed KeyError('cal_rows').
verification.limits: Did not execute compile_model or filesystem writes.
